opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Up to £20,000 (New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Long-Term Research); up to £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures and Publications); up to £2,500 (Research and Travel)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating in a non-profit capacity for at least 12 months). Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators may apply under the Research and Travel category. Individuals independently wishing to create/develop their own practice are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and funds research that expands the appreciation of sculpture. Categories: New Projects and Commissions (exhibitions, catalogues, commissions), Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, Long-Term Research grants, and Research and Travel grants. Applications considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open (closes 1 September 2026), with Winter (open 1 Nov), Spring (open 1 Feb 2027) and Summer (open 1 May 2027) rounds forthcoming.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire provided, plus travel and subsistence expenses: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, Rest of world up to £1,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators, artists and established scholars working on historic and contemporary sculpture. Institute fellowships cover broad sculpture topics; Studios & Gardens fellowships are for research on Henry Moore specifically. No studio facilities offered.
opportunities.summary: Month-long fellowships at the Henry Moore Institute in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens, enabling researchers to use the Sculpture Research Library, Archive of Sculptors' Papers and sculpture collections. Includes Visiting Research Fellowships, Artist Research Fellowships and longer six-week Senior Fellowships. Applications are closed for 2026/27; the next round will open in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to BA and MA students of all disciplines
opportunities.summary: Each year two prizes are awarded for outstanding writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. The 2026 prize winners have been announced; submissions for the 2026 prize will open in autumn.
